description: Read the current page's content and controls, with element refs (such as e5) that click, fill, get_text and screenshot accept. After a person hands a supervised session back, this or screenshot is the fresh observation required before the next action. The page comes back as an accessibility tree: roles, names, values and states. On large pages it scopes itself to the main content; selector, max_depth, max_chars, visible_only and exclude_selectors narrow it further.

exclude_selectors.description: CSS selectors to exclude from the tree (e.g. ["nav", "footer", ".ad-slot"]). Elements are hidden before snapshotting.

frame.description: A CSS selector for an iframe, or a list of them for nested iframes. selector, label and ref then resolve inside it.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters to return. Truncates at nearest line boundary.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth. Limits nesting to get a structural overview without deep details.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope the tree to a specific element (e.g. "#search-results", "main"). If omitted on large pages, auto-scopes to the main landmark.

visible_only.description: Only include visible elements. Skips hidden menus, modals, and offscreen content.

name: get_a11y_tree
title: Read page
